{{Infobox auto}}

'''Pumpkin curry''' is an oven meal of the [[pumpkin]]. It heals {{Value|Pumpkin Curry|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for {{Value|Pumpkin Curry|duration|effect=Resistance}}, the longest Resistance from food. It is the only oven meal that can't be cooked on [[kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/pumpkin_curry.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[pumpkin curry stock]] cooks into pumpkin curry in {{Value|Pumpkin Curry|cook_time}} in an [[oven]]. Obtaining the stock unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Pumpkin Curry|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Pumpkin Curry|heals}} and gives Resistance {{Value|Pumpkin Curry|level|effect=Resistance}} for {{Value|Pumpkin Curry|duration|effect=Resistance|format=clock}}. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_40.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== Advancements ==
* ''Fortified Goodness'': make pumpkin curry (1 [[obol]]).
